newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Electrolux shares rise ahead of report.
newsitem.headline: Electrolux shares rise ahead of report.

text.p: Shares in Swedish household appliance maker Electrolux AB rose on the Stockholm bourse on Wednesday ahead of the company releasing its 1996 figures on Friday .
At 0945 GMT, the share was up 2.7 percent, or 11 crowns, at 426 crowns, while the exchange's general index was up 0.97 percent at 2,506.16.
"There could be speculation about higher than expected earnings," said a trader with a Stockholm bank.
A Reuters poll of 12 analysts showed expectations of an Electrolux 1996 profit after financial items of 3.49 billion crowns compared to 4.02 billion crowns a year earlier.

Another broker said the rise could also be due to a more positive investment mood after U.S. rival Whirlpool Corp on Tuesday reported a sharp rebound in earnings for the latest quarter, due to gains in North America and Latin America.
